classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

assumptions: target_pdb must be supplied as a runtime parameter before execution; no PDB file or accession was provided in the request.
Two trajectory-seed shards (seeds 42 and 43, num_designs 1 each) satisfy the 'at most one or two candidates' constraint while respecting the tool's recommended_shard_size of 1.
filter_mode permissive is chosen to maximise the chance of at least one design clearing BindCraft thresholds at this minimal design count.
num_recycles is kept at 1 (BindCraft default) for speed; raising to 3-5 would improve AF2 confidence at higher GPU cost.
binder_length is fixed at 60 residues (BindCraft default); adjust params.binder_length for epitopes requiring longer coverage.

BindCraft runs AF2 internally and embeds pLDDT, iPAE, and shape-complementarity scores in each design object; rank_designs therefore covers the structural-quality evaluation step without a separate structure predictor.

Per-residue sequence-level analysis (composition, charge, liabilities) can be appended as a post-rank step once design sequences are extracted; it is omitted here to keep the plan minimal and executable.
target_chain defaults to A; supply params.target_chain if the binding interface resides on a different chain.
plan.goal: Design up to two candidate protein binders against the supplied target PDB using two parallel BindCraft trajectory-seed shards, then rank both candidates by BindCraft AF2-derived structural quality metrics.
missing_inputs: target_pdb: no target structure file or PDB accession was provided; supply a local .pdb path as params.target_pdb before launching the workflow.

success_criteria.candidate_count: rank_designs returns at least 1 ranked candidate
success_criteria.structural_quality_signal: each candidate carries BindCraft AF2 metrics (pLDDT, iPAE) from the designs output
success_criteria.top_k_returned: rank_designs top_k capped at 2 to match the at-most-two-candidate requirement
